svg.text: Circuit: cell-tap voltage sensing (board A, architecture section 5)
Four identical channels. Divider ratio about 0.145: 16.8 V at B+ becomes 2.44 V at the ADC. Each channel is calibrated at Gate 1.
Ground: the 56 kΩ legs and the ADS1115 share the electronics ground (P−). J1 pin 1 (B−) is left unconnected: joining B− to this ground would bypass the hardware BMS switch.
Cell voltages are differences of taps: V1 = A0, V2 = A1 − A0, V3 = A2 − A1, V4 = A3 − A2 (after calibration).
